method: Run the production PDF helper once with a temporary runtime override that keeps hyperref in draft mode for every pass. Tagging remains on for every pass. The source, fixture and compile helper are otherwise unchanged.
decision: Diagnostic only: all-draft hyperlink mode reduces the N=100 helper time, but removes every link annotation and named destination. The result shows that active link generation is a significant cost on this fixture; the candidate does not meet the output requirements and is not retained.
next_step: Investigate whether link generation can be made cheaper while retaining every PDF annotation, destination, Link structure element and the same visible text.
limitations: One diagnostic run on one machine at N=100. No N=1,000 compile or full visual review was performed. The diagnostic PDF is not a usable production book because it has no hyperlinks or named destinations.
